shown in the figure below, and the state transition occurs in a clockwise or counter-
clockwise direction.

questions.promptText: Q14. Which of the following is an appropriate explanation of parallel processing?

options.text:
It is the division of a series of processing into processing units that can be executed
simultaneously, and the execution of these on multiple CPUs.

It is the execution of multiple related processes that are grouped together as a single
process.

It is the performing of business logic and database processes on the server side, and the
performing of user interface processes on the client side.

It is the division of processing time for a single CPU into short units, and the sequential
allocation of these to multiple applications for execution.

questions.promptText: Q39. Which of the following is an explanation of spyware?

options.text:
It is a scam where money is demanded just by viewing a web site or clicking an image
on it.

It is a mechanism where an attacker packages attack tools such as log removal or a back
door and hides them in a PC so that the attacker can use them after intrusion.

It is a program that infects a large number of PCs and performs actions such as
simultaneous attacks by illegitimately operating the PCs as instructed over a network.

It is a program that is installed without the user knowing and collects information such
as the user’s personal information and access history.

distributed and stored on multiple disks.

It implements high confidentiality because it employs authentication that uses fingerprint
and iris in addition to a password.

It implements high convenience because once a user is authenticated, he or she is
allowed to use multiple services without any more authentication.
